core: named, hexadecimal, rgb(), and hsl() notation

claims.claim: CSS color values can be represented by named colors, hexadecimal notation, and rgb() or hsl() functional notation.
The modern rgb() and hsl() functions accept an optional alpha component separated with a slash.
The currentColor keyword represents the computed value of an element's color property and can be used where a CSS color is accepted.
The color property sets an element's foreground text color and is inherited.
A translucent foreground color blends with what is behind it, so its visible result depends on its backdrop.
